edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
